title: Rated power agrees with output voltage and current
rationale: The requested operating point must be internally consistent.
source: course_requirements.json: rated output power, voltage and current
closure_if_fail: Return to S1 and reconcile the requirements.

title: Boost input maximum is below output voltage
rationale: A Boost stage cannot regulate below its input voltage.
closure_if_fail: Return to S3 and select a suitable topology or revise requirements.

title: Switching frequency is within the course range
rationale: The design must honor the assigned switching-frequency constraint.
closure_if_fail: Return to S4 and select an in-range frequency.

title: Required protection function is defined
rationale: Required protection needs a threshold and an action.
closure_if_fail: Return to S4 and define the missing protection.

title: Selected MCU matches the course controller requirement
rationale: The MCU must satisfy the required controller class.
closure_if_fail: Return to S6 and choose a compliant MCU.

title: A component passing hard constraints is selected
rationale: A design cannot be handed off with a required component category unresolved.
closure_if_fail: Return to S6, resolve the candidate constraints, or document a requirement conflict.

title: Selected part has a verified LCSC identifier
rationale: The handoff must identify traceable procurement evidence.
closure_if_fail: Verify the manufacturer and LCSC listing or replace the part.

title: Duty limit covers modeled operating corners
rationale: The converter must reach its required operating points with margin.
closure_if_fail: Return to S4/S6 and resolve duty or component headroom.

title: Duty limit remains below the modeled gain-peak region
rationale: Operating beyond the usable gain region can make regulation unreachable.
source: boost_model.py gain_peak and protection duty limit
closure_if_fail: Return to S4/S6 and revise the duty limit or power stage.

title: Hardware OVP protects the modeled uncontrolled output
rationale: The hardware protection threshold must be reachable before the modeled peak becomes unsafe.
closure_if_fail: Return to S4 and revise OVP/TVS coordination.

title: Protection thresholds are ordered below minimum TVS breakdown
rationale: Protection layers must act in order before the TVS enters breakdown.
closure_if_fail: Return to S4/S6 and revise thresholds or TVS selection.

title: TVS clamp voltage is below MOSFET voltage rating
rationale: The clamp must not expose the switching device to a voltage beyond its rating.
closure_if_fail: Replace the TVS or MOSFET after checking transient conditions.

title: TVS clamp voltage is below output capacitor rating
rationale: The output capacitor must tolerate the specified clamp condition.
closure_if_fail: Select compatible parts and check pulse conditions.

title: Current limit thresholds are correctly ordered
rationale: The requested current must remain below software and hardware protection thresholds.
closure_if_fail: Return to S4 and revise current thresholds.

title: Fault inductor peak and input protection coordination are verified
rationale: Output current protection alone does not bound every inductor fault current.
closure_if_fail: Add/verify independent input protection and fault withstand.

title: TVS coordination is verified under full conditions
rationale: A pulse-only clamp value does not prove temperature, parasitic and fault-energy coordination.
source: TVS datasheet pulse conditions and hardware test plan
closure_if_fail: Validate the complete transient path on hardware.

title: Modeled inductor peak is below saturation current
rationale: The selected inductor must remain below its documented saturation limit.
closure_if_fail: Return to S5/S6 and increase inductor current margin.

title: Modeled inductor RMS current is below thermal rating
rationale: The inductor must satisfy its documented temperature-rise current rating.
closure_if_fail: Return to S5/S6 and select a higher-rated inductor.

title: Inductor ripple ratio meets the internal design target
rationale: The ripple target controls current stress and operating margin.
closure_if_fail: Revisit S5/S6 or document an approved tradeoff.

title: Output capacitor ripple current is below its rating
rationale: Capacitor RMS current must remain within the datasheet limit.
closure_if_fail: Increase the capacitor ripple-current capability.

title: Output voltage ADC remains within range at hardware OVP
rationale: The measurement path must not saturate before protection can be evaluated.
closure_if_fail: Return to S5/S6 and revise the divider or ADC range.

title: Output current ADC remains within range at hardware OCP
rationale: The current measurement path must retain headroom at the protection threshold.
closure_if_fail: Return to S5/S6 and revise the sensing gain or threshold.

title: Output voltage ADC resolution meets the target
rationale: ADC quantization must be small compared with the regulation requirement.
closure_if_fail: Return to S5 and revise the divider/reference/ADC configuration.

title: Output current ADC resolution meets the target
rationale: ADC quantization must be small compared with the current regulation requirement.
closure_if_fail: Return to S5 and revise the shunt/gain/ADC configuration.

title: Current measurement partial error budget meets its target
rationale: Measurement error consumes the available steady-state accuracy budget.
closure_if_fail: Complete the error budget and calibration plan.

title: Voltage measurement planning error budget meets its target
rationale: Divider, ADC and reference errors consume the available accuracy budget.
closure_if_fail: Complete the error budget and calibration plan.

title: Full measurement error and hardware threshold tolerance are closed
rationale: Protection thresholds depend on the complete sensing path and reference tolerances.
source: MCU, amplifier and reference datasheets; hardware routing review
closure_if_fail: Verify the complete ADC/comparator/DAC path and tolerance budget.

title: Estimated efficiency meets course target and internal margin
rationale: Efficiency is a course target and informs thermal design.
closure_if_fail: Review loss assumptions and component selection.

title: Estimated component junction temperature is below limit
rationale: Semiconductor thermal margin must be checked at modeled corners.
source: losses.json thermal model and component datasheet
closure_if_fail: Improve thermal design or select a lower-loss component.

title: Output ripple meets course hard limit and target
rationale: Output ripple is a specified electrical performance requirement.
source: losses.json ripple model and course requirements
closure_if_fail: Return to S5/S6 and revise capacitance or power-stage design.

title: Input inrush mitigation is verified
rationale: Digital soft start does not limit passive input-capacitor charging before PWM starts.
source: design_rules.md §5 and input protection test plan
closure_if_fail: Validate independent input ramp limiting and supply energy on hardware.

title: Fuse I2t is compared with the linear inrush estimate
rationale: This comparison is a screening check, not a full fuse coordination proof.
source: fuse datasheet and losses.json inrush estimate
closure_if_fail: Review fuse coordination and document its limits.

title: CC/CV loop stability and modeled operating points are verified
rationale: The digital controller must be stable and reach the specified operating points.
closure_if_fail: Return to S4/S6 and redesign the loop or operating range.

title: PWM resolution is at least 10 bits
rationale: The PWM timer must provide sufficient duty-cycle resolution.
closure_if_fail: Revise timer clock or PWM frequency.

title: Control interrupt CPU load is below 50 percent
rationale: The control loop needs execution-time margin.
closure_if_fail: Optimize control execution or revise timing.

title: UART log load is below 50 percent
rationale: Debug output must not monopolize the communication link.
closure_if_fail: Reduce log rate or increase baud rate.

title: CC operating range and short-circuit boundary are stated
rationale: The handoff must state where constant-current operation is controllable.
closure_if_fail: Return to S1/S4 and document the operating boundary.

title: DCM, no-load, pulse-stop and CC/CV behavior are verified
rationale: CCM averaged loop analysis does not establish switching behavior in DCM or transitions.
closure_if_fail: Run switching simulation and hardware validation.

title: LDO dropout margin is at least 200 mV
rationale: The auxiliary rail must remain regulated at minimum input voltage.
closure_if_fail: Select a suitable LDO or revise auxiliary supply.

title: Gate-driver supply exceeds UVLO and operating minimum
rationale: The gate driver must remain operational at minimum input and load.
source: parts_db.json gate_driver.params.uvlo_on_v/vdd_min_v and pmos/fuse resistance; design_rules.md §9.1
closure_if_fail: Select a driver with adequate supply margin or revise input path.

title: Efficiency assumption agrees with loss model
rationale: The first-pass efficiency assumption should be consistent with the detailed model.
closure_if_fail: Update the assumption and rerun downstream calculations.

title: Model assumptions and physical power/sampling timing are verified
rationale: Simulation and analytical models do not prove parasitics, thermal behavior or MCU timing on hardware.
source: model assumptions and hardware validation plan
closure_if_fail: Record hardware measurements and timing validation.

title: Switching simulation matches the current design revision
rationale: Simulation evidence is valid only for the design revision it analyzed.
closure_if_fail: Rerun switching simulation for the current revision.

title: Switching simulation scenario meets its acceptance criterion
rationale: Time-domain simulation checks dynamic behavior outside averaged steady-state analysis.
source: sim.json scenario checks and T1 acceptance matrix
closure_if_fail: Inspect the waveform and return to the relevant design stage.

title: Rated switching result cross-checks against the averaged model
rationale: Independent model agreement helps detect simulator or parameter errors.
closure_if_fail: Review model assumptions, parameters and metric definitions.

title: Output overcurrent simulation verifies debounce and hardware trip cases
rationale: Protection must distinguish short transients from sustained faults and latch trips.
source: sim.json SR87 scenarios and T1 protection validation
closure_if_fail: Review thresholds, delay and trip behavior; confirm on hardware.

title: Independent input ramp bounds cold-plug current
rationale: A current-limited input ramp addresses inrush before the converter control loop starts.
source: sim.json SR88 scenarios and input protection validation
closure_if_fail: Validate ramp slope, source energy and PWM inhibit on hardware.
